criteria.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 has a mechanism naming an existing crates/ path and function (not "none"), owner Athena kept, and a measure ending in `status: <label>` where the label is a line `athena status` prints, or `status: not shown` plus the test name. Check by Grep on docs/spec.toml and on the named function in crates/.
criteria.evidence: Grep on docs/spec.toml lines 1534-1537: mechanism names crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs improvement_cycle and crates/athena-core/src/status.rs improvement_cycle_line. Both functions exist in the diff (introspection.rs `pub fn improvement_cycle`, status.rs `pub fn improvement_cycle_line`). owner = "Athena". The measure is "cargo test -p athena-data introspection; the improvement cycle: line of athena status; status: not shown": it ends in `status: not shown` and names the test command and filter.

criteria.criterion: In crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs, fn improvement_cycle no longer contains a `jobs.len() >= 2`-style filter for the evaluated stage. A code comment names the record field used as the evaluation signal. Check with Grep for the removed filter and the comment.
criteria.evidence: Grep for `jobs\.len\(\)|sources\.len\(\)` in introspection.rs finds only test asserts (lines 833 and 950), none in improvement_cycle. Line 697 has the comment "The evaluation signal is `ProposalRecord::evaluation`, and only a valid one counts." The evaluated filter is `p.evaluation.as_ref().is_some_and(|e| e.validate().is_ok())`.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-data introspection`. Tests with fixtures shaped like real records show: a proposal with no evaluation record is not counted as evaluated; one with an evaluation record is; a finding about a different failure class or introspection than the proposal does not complete the chain; and a set missing any one stage reports that stage missing. The tests fail if the check always returns shown or always missing.
criteria.evidence: 12 passed, 0 failed. These tests cover each case: counts_a_proposal_without_an_evaluation_as_not_evaluated (3 distinct source jobs, accepted, still missing Evaluated and Adoption); is_shown_when_the_linked_proposal_is_evaluated_and_decided; ignores_a_finding_about_another_class_and_introspection (missing Candidate, Evaluated, Adoption); reports_each_single_missing_stage (repair, finding, candidate, evaluated, adoption). The tests assert both shown and specific missing lists, so a check that always returned shown or always returned missing would fail them.

criteria.criterion: An empty record set reports not shown, never success (no-empty-success). A test in `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` covers it.
criteria.evidence: introspection_cycle_of_an_empty_record_set_is_not_shown passed. It asserts !shown and that all five stages are missing. status.rs a_status_over_no_records_does_not_claim_the_cycle also passed under `cargo test -p athena-core status`.

criteria.evidence: introspection_cycle_replay_over_mixed_proposals_finds_both_outcomes passed. It asserts results == [true, false, false], that both outcomes occur, and that each proposal has 3 distinct source jobs.

findings.summary: Files changed outside the expected deliverables
findings.evidence: Neither file is on the deliverables list. Each change is one `evaluation: None,` line, which ProposalRecord's new field requires for the code to compile. Listed commands.rs is unchanged. The changes are harmless but out of scope.

findings.summary: No code writes the evaluation field, and adoption is not checked against the evaluation result
findings.evidence: Grep for "evaluation" in the evidence snapshot records finds 0 matches, and no code path in the diff sets `evaluation: Some(...)` outside tests. The stage can only become true by editing records by hand, until something records the result. The decided stage also accepts an Accepted proposal whose candidate_failures exceed baseline_failures. Comparing the two counts, as method_experiment::compare does, would make the decision evidence-based, as OLY-10-02 says. This matches the reading's expected honest `not shown` on today's data, so it is not blocking.

findings.summary: The repair stage is not tied to the rest of the chain
findings.evidence: repair is true when any landed job is named by any introspection or any proposal source, regardless of whether that job relates to the evaluated, decided proposal. Finding, candidate, evaluated and adoption are linked to each other, but repair is a separate any-match. A stricter check would require the landed repair to be named by the finding or the proposal that completes the chain. The spec describes "one request that ends in" all five stages.

summary: The retry fixes what was wrong with the rejected attempt. A candidate now counts as "evaluated" only when its proposal has a valid recorded baseline-versus-candidate result in the new optional `ProposalRecord::evaluation` field. Before, any proposal citing two or more jobs counted, which is true of every real proposal. A proposal also has to cite a finding's introspection id or share its failure class before it counts toward the chain. `athena status` prints an `improvement cycle:` line. When nothing is recorded, that line reads `not shown`, never success. docs/spec.toml OLY-10-02 now names the mechanism and gives `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry, and the build_measurement_line doc comment is back in place. I ran `cargo test -p athena-data introspection` (12 passed), `cargo test -p athena-cli` (all passed) and `cargo test -p athena-core status` (69 passed). fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded CI run. No record in the evidence snapshot contains `"evaluation"`, so on real data the line honestly reads not shown. Findings, all minor: (1) nothing in the code writes the evaluation field yet, and the adoption decision is not checked against the evaluation result; (2) the repair stage is any landed job that any introspection or proposal names, not one tied to the evaluated proposal; (3) evidence_labels.rs and proposals.rs are outside the deliverables list, each with a one-line `evaluation: None` that the new field needs in order to compile.
